parameters: cD (contact rate with infectious dead bodies)
ω (rate at which infected individuals become infectious)
description: An SEIR compartmental model with a fifth compartment for the infectious deceased (DI) to model the dynamics of an Ebola outbreak in a village of a thousand people. The model includes transmission from both living infectious individuals and infectious corpses. The paper promises to model the effect of vaccination and quarantine on the epidemic's outcome and use sensitivity analysis to determine effective intervention targets.
